classifications.rationale: The President recounts an earlier direction to DHS and subsequent agency action, but this segment imposes no present command or legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: I directed the Secretary of Homeland Security to issue new policy guidance

classifications.rationale: Within 45 days, the Secretary of Homeland Security, coordinating with specified officials, must provide the President a report about agency measures; the required consequence is internal reporting, not a dictated legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: shall submit a report to the President detailing all measures

classifications.rationale: Within 75 days, the Attorney General and Secretary of Homeland Security, after consultation, must report to the President on potentially needed resources or authority; this is an internal review and reporting requirement.
classifications.evidence: shall submit a report to the President identifying any additional resources or authorities

classifications.rationale: Within 60 days, the Secretaries of State and Homeland Security must report on measures and sanctions implementation, while the savings clause preserves existing agency and OMB authority; neither provision itself imposes sanctions or changes legal rights.
